43d3cea9: What is the name of Demon Slayer's main protagonist?
Tanjiro Kamado is a boy whose family is slaughtered by a demon. He becomes a demon slayer to find a cure for his sister Nezuko, who was turned into a demon.
ce685cd1: Why is Nezuko Kamado different from other demons?
She keeps her humanity and protects humans
She resists sunlight from the start
Nezuko is exceptional among demons because she keeps her human emotions and protects humans instead of devouring them, unlike every other demon.
7c0bcd29: What is the name of the supreme leader of the demons?
Muzan Kibutsuji is the Demon King, the first and most powerful demon — he created all the others by giving them his blood.
4fa7c48c: Which Breathing Style does Tanjiro mainly use?
Tanjiro masters Water Breathing, taught by his master Sakonji Urokodaki. He later also develops Sun Breathing.
93b8eb37: What is the name of the organization that fights demons?
The Demon Slayer Corps is the secret organization founded to fight and destroy demons in Taishō-era Japan.
d8f65506: Which Breathing Style does Zenitsu master?
Zenitsu has mastered only one technique of Thunder Breathing: the First Form, Thunderclap and Flash. He refines it to the extreme.
2cc6a498: How did Inosuke Hashibira learn to fight?
On his own, living in the forest among boars
Inosuke grew up wild in the mountains among boars after being abandoned. He developed his fighting style and his Beast Breathing on his own.
ffd95cbf: What are the Upper Moons in Demon Slayer?
The Twelve Kizuki are Muzan's 12 elite demons. The 6 Upper Moons (Jōgen) are the strongest — the 6 Lower Moons (Kagen) are weaker.
b1e1dddd: What is Akaza's rank among the Upper Moons?
Akaza is Upper Moon Three — a fight-loving demon who refuses to kill women. He faces Rengoku in the Mugen Train arc.
ce182bc3: Which Hashira dies in the Mugen Train arc?
Kyojuro Rengoku, the Flame Hashira, dies after his epic fight against Akaza (Upper Moon Three) — his death is one of the most memorable moments of the series.
f4d65d07: What is the universal weakness of all demons?
Sunlight turns demons to ash. Nichirin swords and wisteria poison can also wound or weaken them.
c06c691f: What is the name of the demon slayers' special sword that changes color?
Nichirin blades are forged from ore exposed to the sun all year round — they are the only weapons that can cut off a demon's head.
7dd4a1b3: What color does Tanjiro's blade turn when he first draws it?
Tanjiro's blade turns black, an extremely rare color. It is said that wielders of a black blade never become Hashira.
cc04bf08: Who is the master who trains Tanjiro in the mountains?
Sakonji Urokodaki is the former Water Hashira who takes Tanjiro under his wing. He teaches him Water Breathing and makes him a fox mask.
9c587e82: Which demon is Upper Moon One and was once a demon slayer?
Kokushibo (Michikatsu Tsugikuni) is Upper Moon One — he was once the twin brother of Yoriichi Tsugikuni, the creator of Sun Breathing.
8b5e6240: Which Hashira leads the undercover mission in the Yoshiwara Entertainment District?
Tengen Uzui is the Sound Hashira — a former high-ranking shinobi with three wives, he fights Upper Moon Six (Gyutaro and Daki) in the Entertainment District.
eecf222f: What is the full name of Upper Moon Six (two entities)?
Gyutaro and Daki are two demons sharing the same body — an inseparable brother and sister who share their vitality. Both heads must be cut off at the same time.
19eddb5c: What is the original Breathing from which all Breathing Styles derive?
Sun Breathing (the Hinokami Kagura) is the original Breathing created by Yoriichi Tsugikuni — every other Breathing Style is an adapted derivative of it.
2c19345f: What is the ancestral dance passed from father to son in the Kamado family?
The Hinokami Kagura is the Kamado family's ritual dance performed every New Year — it is actually Sun Breathing, passed on as a dance so that it would survive through history.
76fd0fc2: What is the Demon Slayer Mark?
A red mark that appears on demon slayers under extreme conditions
The seal of the Twelve Kizuki
The Demon Slayer Mark appears on the body when body temperature rises above 39°C and the heart beats over 200 times a minute — it doubles or triples the bearer's abilities.
8fc38364: The founder of the Demon Slayer Corps
The most powerful demon slayer in history, creator of Sun Breathing
Yoriichi Tsugikuni is the legendary demon slayer of the Sengoku era — he created Sun Breathing and is the only man who nearly killed Muzan in single combat.
5dd41006: Where does Tanjiro go to have his sword repaired in season 3?
The Swordsmith Village is a secret village where smiths forge Nichirin blades — Tanjiro goes there to repair his sword and meets the Hashira Muichiro and Mitsuri.
da5f531a: Mitsuri Kanroji is the Love Hashira — her extraordinarily flexible body and unique whip-like blade give her an unmatched acrobatic fighting style.
db0426f1: What is the bond between Shinobu Kocho and Kanao Tsuyuri?
Kanao is Shinobu Kocho's student and adoptive sister — the Kocho sisters saved her from slavery and Shinobu taught her the Breathing derived from her own style.
2458876b: How does Shinobu Kocho make up for her lack of strength to behead demons?
Shinobu Kocho cannot cut off demons' heads — she poisons them with massive doses of wisteria, a toxin deadly to demons.
77dc56f3: What is the official title of the leader of the Hashira?
Oyakata-sama (Master) refers to Kagaya Ubuyashiki, the hereditary head of the Demon Slayer Corps — his family is cursed and its members die young.
6f30edba: What is the Thirteenth Form of Sun Breathing?
Chaining the first twelve forms in an endless loop
The Thirteenth Form consists of endlessly chaining the first twelve forms. Yoriichi designed it to strike all of Muzan's vital organs.
3b03175d: What is special about Nezuko's blood?
Nezuko's blood can set Nichirin blades ablaze, turning them burning red — this demonic flame only burns demons and does not hurt humans.
dca8c1fb: What is the lowest rank in the Demon Slayer Corps?
Mizunoto is the lowest of the Demon Slayer Corps' ten ranks. Tanjiro starts at this rank after surviving the Final Selection.
33ffac3e: Which trial must Tanjiro pass to join the Demon Slayer Corps?
Survive 7 days in the selection forest
The Final Selection takes place on Mount Fujikasane, surrounded by wisteria — candidates must survive 7 days among captured demons. Many die there.
74244cf1: Which of Muzan's demons is sent aboard the Mugen Train to eliminate the demon slayers?
Enmu is Lower Moon One — Muzan gives him more blood so he can kill Tanjiro by trapping every passenger of the Mugen Train in endless dreams.
6e922808: Which technique does Zenitsu create on his own, in honor of his master?
Zenitsu creates the Seventh Form of Thunder Breathing on his own: Flaming Thunder God — a technique he develops entirely by himself to surpass his master's teachings.
0c3223fa: Which Hashira takes Tanjiro, Inosuke and Zenitsu to the Entertainment District?
Tengen Uzui recruits Tanjiro, Inosuke and Zenitsu to infiltrate the Yoshiwara Entertainment District — he teaches them shinobi infiltration methods.
9991f203: What is the power of Upper Moon Two, Doma?
Doma (Upper Moon Two) uses ice to freeze and absorb his victims — he literally absorbs women to keep them with him. Shinobu dies at his hands.
2ef5aa2d: Which Breathing Style does the Stone Hashira, Gyomei Himejima, use?
Gyomei Himejima uses Stone Breathing — he is the strongest Hashira. Blind since childhood, he wields a chained flail and axe with terrifying precision.
4dc7e450: What is the name of the final fortress where the fight against Muzan takes place?
The Infinity Castle is Nakime's dimensional fortress — an endless labyrinth where the Hashira face the Upper Moons in the final battle.
edfd3109: Why does Muzan particularly fear the Kamado bloodline?
They are immune to his blood
They carry Sun Breathing, the only technique able to kill him
The Kamados' Sun Breathing is the only technique able to destroy Muzan — Yoriichi nearly killed him with it. Muzan therefore tries to exterminate the Kamado family.
bef9093e: What is the link between Tanjiro Kamado and Yoriichi Tsugikuni?
They are direct ancestor and descendant
An ancestor of Tanjiro was Yoriichi's friend
Sumiyoshi, an ancestor of Tanjiro, was a close friend of Yoriichi — Yoriichi taught him Sun Breathing in the form of a ritual dance so that it would survive through the generations.
c018814c: What is the outcome of the final battle against Muzan?
Tanjiro kills him and survives unharmed
Tanjiro briefly becomes a demon, then turns human again, and Muzan dies in the sun

As he dies, Muzan pours all his blood into Tanjiro, turning him into a demon. Tanjiro resists thanks to Nezuko and the wisteria medicine — he is brought back to humanity and Muzan perishes in the sun.
968b830a: How many seasons of the Demon Slayer anime aired before the Infinity Castle film trilogy?
The series has four seasons, up to the Hashira Training arc. The rest is adapted for cinemas, in three films devoted to the Infinity Castle.
2ca1512b: What is the link between Kokushibo and Yoriichi?
Kokushibo (Michikatsu) and Yoriichi Tsugikuni are twin brothers — unable to match his brother, Michikatsu chose to become a demon to gain eternal life.
553b9b3d: Mitsuri Kanroji's Breathing derives from which other Breathing?
Mitsuri's Love Breathing derives from Flame Breathing — adapted to her unique muscles, eight times denser than a normal human's.
06faad11: What is the Transparent World used by the best demon slayers?
The ability to clearly perceive the inside of an enemy's body
The Transparent World is an ultimate form of perception — seeing an opponent's muscles, blood vessels and bones, anticipating their attacks and finding their vital points.
f047c4ce: Which demon embodies human emotions through several clones?
Hantengu is Upper Moon Four — he splits into clones that each represent an emotion (anger, joy, sorrow, pleasure). Defeating the clones reveals his tiny true body.
82c90004: How many wives does Tengen Uzui have?
Tengen Uzui has three wives: Makio, Suma and Hinatsuru — all three are former kunoichi trained since childhood in his shinobi clan.
30127c01: What is Kyojuro Rengoku's motto about the strong and the weak?
The strong must crush the weak
The strong must protect the weak — that is why they were born strong
“Those born strong have a duty to protect the weak” is Rengoku's philosophy. These words, passed on by his mother, guide his whole life.
e4955da0: Which Hashira is blind but considered the most powerful?
Gyomei Himejima, the Stone Hashira, is blind but has superior sensory perception — he is recognized as the strongest Hashira of the current generation.
e67f62c2: In which historical period of Japan is Demon Slayer set?
Demon Slayer is set in the Taishō era (1912-1926) — a period of modernization in Japan when ancestral traditions coexisted with new Western technologies.
2d9ce2a5: How does Tanjiro recognize demons or bad people?
Tanjiro has a superhuman sense of smell — he can detect emotions, wounds, poisons and enemies' intentions by scent. It is his most developed sense.
37d0abc0: What is the meaning of Tanjiro's earrings?
Yoriichi's legacy passed on to his ancestors
The symbol of the Demon Slayer Corps
The sun-shaped hanafuda earrings are Yoriichi Tsugikuni's legacy, passed on to the Kamado family — they symbolize the mastery of Sun Breathing.
5153fc33: What happens to Nezuko at the end of the series?
She becomes human again thanks to a medicine
Thanks to the medicine developed by Tamayo and Yushiro, Nezuko becomes human again at the end of the series — one of the Demon Slayer Corps' few complete victories.
14456df3: Exposed to the rising sun after a night of fighting
The surviving demon slayers hold Muzan in combat all night until dawn — the rising sun destroys him after more than 1,000 years of existence.
4ff76cbd: What does Ubuyashiki use to weaken Muzan at the start of the final battle?
He sacrifices his house by blowing it up with himself and his family
Kagaya Ubuyashiki sacrifices his life and his family's by blowing up the Ubuyashiki mansion with Muzan inside — it does not kill him but traps him in the blast.
446740c6: Which character was once a disciple of Jigoro Kuwajima alongside Zenitsu?
Kaigaku was the senior disciple of Jigoro (Zenitsu's master) — he betrayed the Demon Slayer Corps by becoming a demon through Kokushibo's blood.
9518a389: What is the name of the artist demon, Upper Moon Five, who emerges from pots?
Gyokko (Upper Moon Five) emerges from pots and creates morbid sculptures out of human bodies — he faces Muichiro Tokito in the Swordsmith Village.
6637e4fc: What does Muichiro Tokito unlock when he recovers his memories?
When he recovers his memories while facing Gyokko, Muichiro's Demon Slayer Mark appears, and his power multiplies.
17d76925: How many forms does Thunder Breathing have in total?
Thunder Breathing has 6 official forms — Zenitsu only masters the First Form but perfects it to the extreme. He later creates the Seventh Form (Flaming Thunder God) on his own.
49b2aec5: What is the name of the Breathing technique Inosuke developed on his own?
Beast Breathing is Inosuke's wild style — developed alone in the mountains by imitating animals. He uses two swords whose blades he chipped himself.
078de7a0: Which demon rules over Mount Natagumo?
Rui is Lower Moon Five, who controls Mount Natagumo — he creates a fake “family” of demons bound by his threads. Tanjiro faces him in the spider mountain arc.
c2770012: What is the name of Tanjiro's father, who taught him the Hinokami Kagura?
Tanjuro Kamado is Tanjiro's father — he danced the Hinokami Kagura every New Year despite his serious illness. His frail body hid a mysterious connection to the original Sun Breathing.
37084706: What is special about the Demon Slayer Marks?
They multiply power but cut life expectancy to 25
They let you see demons in sunlight
Demon Slayer Marks multiply the bearer's power — but doom those who develop them to die before age 25. Only Yoriichi Tsugikuni, the creator of Sun Breathing, lived longer.
cd1c754b: Which Hashira uses Wind Breathing in the Demon Slayer Corps?
Sanemi Shinazugawa is the Wind Hashira — known for his explosive temper and his early hostility toward Nezuko. His many scars bear witness to a tragic story tied to his own family.
